newsitem.title: TURKEY: Ten massacred in raid on house in Turkey.
newsitem.headline: Ten massacred in raid on house in Turkey.

text.p: Ten people including two children were killed when unknown assailants sprayed automatic gunfire inside an Istanbul house on Sunday, Turkish police and television said.
"Ten people, among them two children and five women, were shot dead," a local police commissioner told Reuters.
The private ATV television station showed footage of blood stains on upturned beds in the house. Interior walls were pockmarked with dozens of bullet holes and splashed with blood.
Many of the dead were members of the same family from the province of Siirt in Turkey's mainly-Kurdish southeast, ATV said.
The gunmen attacked the single-storey house in the city's run down Esenler district at 4 a.m. (0100 GMT), the police officer said.
"We can give no information on any suspects and we do not know enough to say who did it," the police officer said.
The television station said the killings may have been related to the Kurdish separatist rebellion in southeast Turkey or part of a family vendetta, common in the area.
